Optimizers

Source: R/example_optimizers.R
optimizers.Rd

Ports of the optimizers of jax.example_libraries.optimizers. Each constructor returns an optimizer list(init_fn, update_fn, params_fn) (see optimizers_Optimizer()) that works on pytrees of parameters: init_fn(params) creates the state, update_fn(step, grads, opt_state) applies one update (step is the 0-based iteration index) and params_fn(opt_state) extracts the parameters.

Usage

optimizers_sgd(step_size)

optimizers_momentum(step_size, mass)

optimizers_nesterov(step_size, mass)

optimizers_adagrad(step_size, momentum = 0.9)

optimizers_rmsprop(step_size, gamma = 0.9, eps = 1e-08)

optimizers_rmsprop_momentum(
  step_size,
  gamma = 0.9,
  eps = 1e-08,
  momentum = 0.9
)

optimizers_adam(step_size, b1 = 0.9, b2 = 0.999, eps = 1e-08)

optimizers_adamax(step_size, b1 = 0.9, b2 = 0.999, eps = 1e-08)

optimizers_sm3(step_size, momentum = 0.9)

Arguments

step_size

Positive scalar, or a schedule (a function of the iteration index returning a positive scalar).

mass

Momentum coefficient (momentum, nesterov).

momentum

Momentum parameter (adagrad, rmsprop_momentum, sm3).

gamma

Decay parameter (rmsprop, rmsprop_momentum).

eps

Small constant for numerical stability.

b1, b2

Exponential decay rates of the first and second moment estimates (adam, adamax).

Value

An optimizer list(init_fn, update_fn, params_fn).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
opt <- optimizers_adam(1e-3)
state <- opt$init_fn(list(w = jnp_ones(3), b = 0))
grads <- list(w = jnp_ones(3), b = 1)
state <- opt$update_fn(0L, grads, state)
opt$params_fn(state)
} # }
